brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit - three hex bases forming an L-shaped compact footprint

requirements.evidence: Drawer frame notch placed at -1,1 level 0 (notch:0#-1,1#notch0) but no drawer socket available; find_sockets for drawer returned 0 even adjacent to notch. Drawer part could not be added.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction of the three pieces
Configurator refused setSpikeAccessory with TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: 'this spike cannot carry a platform' for both platform-lrg and platform-sm

finish.summary: Built L-shaped 3-base compact unit with spike at the three-way junction and drawer-frame notch prepared; drawer insertion and platform accessory blocked by configurator rules.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
